spans.s: CHOCOLATE: *चकलाटम्।

CHOICE (subs.):
I The act of choosing:
(1)
ग्रहणम् (=acceptance);
(2) वरणम् (= a. of a
husband);
(3) अभिलाषः (=desire). Ph. to
make a c. of: v. To choose.
II The power
of c.: v. Option.
III Discrimination:
q. v.
IV The thing chosen: expr. by
adjs: ईप्सितः (ता, तं); अभीष्टः (ष्टा, ष्टं), etc.
Ph.:
who is your c.:
कस्मिंस्ते हृदयाभिनिवेशः;
V. iii.
V The best part of anything:
रत्नम्।

CHOICE (adj.):
I Superior in quality:
(1)
विशिष्टः (ष्टा, ष्टं);
(2) सर्वोत्तमः (मा, मं) (=best);
(3) महार्हः (र्हा, र्हं) (=valuable),
c. bed:
भहार्ह-
शय्या, Ki. Ph.:
with c. food:
भोजनविशेषैः, A.
II Select: q. v.
III Frugal: q. v.

CHOICELY:
I With choice:
(1) समीक्ष्य;
(2)
परितो वीक्ष्य।
II Excellently: q. v.

CHOICENESS:
(1) विशिष्टता;
(2) उत्कर्षः: v.
Excellence.

CHOIR:
I A band of singers:
(1) गायकगणः;
(2) *सङ्गायकगणः।
II A part of a church:
*सङ्गायकभूमिः।

CHOKE:
I To stifle, suffocate: q. v.
II To
check: q. v.
III To offend: q. v.

CHOLER:
I The bile: q. v.: पित्तम्।
II
Anger: q. v.: क्रोधः।
CHOLERA: विसूचिका, Sr.

CHOLERIC:
I Irascible: q. v.: क्रोधनः (ना, नं).
II Angry: q. v.

CHOOSE (v.):
I To select:
(1) वृणीते (वृ, c. 9.)
(=to accept as, husband), whether (she)
would c. me:
वृणीत मां नेति, R. vi. 68.;
(2) मनो
 बध्नाति (बन्ध् c. 9.) (with loc.) (to set one's
mind), she chose (it) in preference to others:
मनो बबन्धान्यरसान् विलंध्य सा, R. iii. 4.;
(3)
अभिलषति (लष्, c. l.), and whom (she) may c.:
यञ्चाभिलषेत्, D. vi.: v. To desire;
(4) by
circum.,
which of the two you c.:
तयोरभिभतं
 वद, Vi. vi.;
(5) गृह्णाति (ग्रह्, c. 9.) (=to
take: only when the context fixes the
meaning).
II To elect, appoint: q. v.
CHOP (subs.): मांसफालिका, N.: v. Piece.

CHOP (v. t.):
I To mince: q. v.: विशकलयति
(nomi.).
II To exchange: q. v.
III To
bandy: q. v. Comp. s: c. off: v. To cut
off; c. up.: v. To devour.
CHOP-HOUSE: *मासंफालिकागृहम्।
CHOPPER, CHOPPING-KNIFE: छुरिकाविशेषः।

CHORAL: साङ्गीतिकः (की, कं), Williams: v.
CHOIR.

CHORD:
I A musical string: तन्त्री।
II
Harmony: q. v.: एकतानः।
III In geo. ज्या or
जीवा, Li.

CHORISTER:
I A singer: गायकः, Kuvera's c.:
किन्नरः।
Indra's c.
गन्धर्वः।
II Leader of a
chorus: प्रधानगायकः (?).
CHOROGAPHER: प्रदेशवर्णकः (?)
CHOROGRAPHY: प्रदेशवर्णनम् (?)

CHORUS:
I A band of singers: गायकगणः and
sim. comp. s.
II Of a song: ध्रुवा
or
ध्रवम्, Gi.
CHOUGH (subs.): काकजातीयपक्षिभेदः।
